criteria.passage: I’d check the repair milestones against the plan, confirm the parts ETA and any workaround, and see whether the shortage threatens the completion date.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly identifies information to monitor execution: milestones, parts ETA, workaround, and impact on completion date.

criteria.passage: If a critical step is slipping or the date is no longer realistic, I’d escalate to the right owner and update the next shift on the revised status.
criteria.rationale: This shows recognition that deviation from plan triggers action, specifically when a critical step slips or the date becomes unrealistic.

criteria.passage: I’d escalate to the right owner and update the next shift on the revised status. Then I’d follow up until the blocker is cleared or the new timeline is confirmed.
criteria.rationale: This directly states escalation to the appropriate owner and continued follow-through until resolution or confirmation of the new timeline.
